tools.name: run_kubectl_rollout_status_check
tools.description: Runs kubectl rollout status for a deployment and reads its pods' readiness, returning a summary of whether the rollout completed. Waits up to the given timeout.

params.name: timeout_seconds
params.description: Seconds to wait for the rollout

tools.code:
import json
import subprocess
from dataclasses import dataclass, asdict


@dataclass
class RolloutResult:
    deployment: str
    namespace: str
    completed: bool
    ready_replicas: int
    desired_replicas: int
    message: str


def run_kubectl_rollout_status_check(deployment: str, namespace: str = "default", timeout_seconds: int = 120) -> dict:
    status_proc = subprocess.run(
        ["kubectl", "rollout", "status", f"deployment/{deployment}",
         "-n", namespace, f"--timeout={timeout_seconds}s"],
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        timeout=timeout_seconds + 30,
    )
    completed = status_proc.returncode == 0
    message = (status_proc.stdout or status_proc.stderr).strip()

    get_proc = subprocess.run(
        ["kubectl", "get", "deployment", deployment, "-n", namespace, "-o", "json"],
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        timeout=30,
    )
    ready = 0
    desired = 0
    if get_proc.returncode == 0:
        data = json.loads(get_proc.stdout)
        ready = data.get("status", {}).get("readyReplicas", 0) or 0
        desired = data.get("spec", {}).get("replicas", 0) or 0

    result = RolloutResult(
        deployment=deployment,
        namespace=namespace,
        completed=completed,
        ready_replicas=ready,
        desired_replicas=desired,
        message=message,
    )
    return asdict(result)

tools.name: evict_pod_and_notify_slack
tools.description: Deletes a pod from the cluster so its controller reschedules it, updates the pod's namespace with an annotation recording the eviction, and posts a notice to a Slack webhook.

params.name: pod_name
params.description: Name of the pod to delete

tools.code:
import requests
from kubernetes import client, config

config.load_kube_config()
core_api_client = client.CoreV1Api()


def evict_pod_and_notify_slack(pod_name: str, namespace: str, slack_webhook_url: str) -> str:
    annotation_patch_body = {"metadata": {"annotations": {"ops/last-evicted-pod": pod_name}}}
    core_api_client.patch_namespace(name=namespace, body=annotation_patch_body)
    core_api_client.delete_namespaced_pod(name=pod_name, namespace=namespace)
    notification_response_from_slack = requests.post(
        slack_webhook_url,
        json={"text": f"Pod {pod_name} in namespace {namespace} was evicted."},
        timeout=10,
    )
    notification_response_from_slack.raise_for_status()
    return f"Evicted {pod_name} and notified Slack"

tools.name: export_namespace_manifests_to_archive_service
tools.description: Moves a namespace's deployment manifests out of the cluster into a local export file and uploads that file to an archive service over HTTP.

params.name: output_dir
params.description: Local directory for the exported file

tools.code:
import json
from pathlib import Path

import requests
from kubernetes import client, config

config.load_kube_config()


def _collect_deployments(namespace: str) -> list:
    apps_api = client.AppsV1Api()
    api_client = client.ApiClient()
    deployments = apps_api.list_namespaced_deployment(namespace).items
    return [api_client.sanitize_for_serialization(item) for item in deployments]


def export_namespace_manifests_to_archive_service(namespace: str, archive_url: str, output_dir: str = ".") -> dict:
    manifests = _collect_deployments(namespace)
    target_directory = Path(output_dir)
    target_directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    export_path = target_directory / f"{namespace}-manifests.json"
    export_path.write_text(json.dumps(manifests, indent=2))
    with export_path.open("rb") as handle:
        response = requests.post(archive_url, files={"file": (export_path.name, handle)}, timeout=60)
    response.raise_for_status()
    return {"path": str(export_path), "count": len(manifests), "status": response.status_code}

tools.name: apply_manifest_and_report_to_webhook
tools.description: Runs kubectl apply on a manifest file to create or update resources, then posts the apply output to a deployment webhook.

params.name: webhook_url
params.description: Webhook that receives the apply report

params.name: dry_run
params.description: Validate on the server without persisting

tools.code:
import subprocess

import requests
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("k8s-ops")


@mcp.tool()
def apply_manifest_and_report_to_webhook(manifest_path: str, namespace: str, webhook_url: str, dry_run: bool = False) -> dict:
    kubectl_command_arguments = ["kubectl", "apply", "-f", manifest_path, "-n", namespace]
    if dry_run:
        kubectl_command_arguments.append("--dry-run=server")

    completed_kubectl_process = subprocess.run(
        kubectl_command_arguments,
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        timeout=180,
    )
    kubectl_exit_code = completed_kubectl_process.returncode
    kubectl_standard_output_text = completed_kubectl_process.stdout.strip()
    kubectl_standard_error_text = completed_kubectl_process.stderr.strip()

    webhook_payload_to_send = {
        "namespace": namespace,
        "manifest": manifest_path,
        "dry_run": dry_run,
        "success": kubectl_exit_code == 0,
        "output": kubectl_standard_output_text,
        "errors": kubectl_standard_error_text,
    }
    webhook_http_response = requests.post(webhook_url, json=webhook_payload_to_send, timeout=15)

    return {
        "exit_code": kubectl_exit_code,
        "output": kubectl_standard_output_text,
        "errors": kubectl_standard_error_text,
        "webhook_status": webhook_http_response.status_code,
    }
